credit.credit-words: Gutiérrez Hidalgo (1553 - 1620) was a composer who lived in Colombia. We dont know many things about his
life, but he was the Chapel Master from Santafé Cathedral in Bogota.
The presence of this composer in Bogotá is manifested in a handwritten choir book existing in the Cathedral of
Bogotá, which contains more than 20 of his works, the only ones that have been preserved to this day, as the rest
of his production has been lost. in very unfortunate circumstances: at the end of his days, while working as
choirmaster at the cathedral of Sucre, he attempted to have his works published in Europe, as can be seen from
a manuscript in the National Archives of Sugar. These compositions surely never reached their destination, missing
the three-decade work of one of South America's most illustrious 16th century musicians.
